Definition: Jehochanan, the name of eight Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jehohanan is the name of eight Israelites, priests, Levites and captains among them. In 1 Chronicles 12:12, Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth. The fuller story is told on the Jehohanan profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Jehohanan is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
